# coolify_application_start

Start a Coolify application. Creating this resource sends a start signal to the specified application. Deleting this resource is a no-op — it does not stop the application.

## Exemplo de Uso

```terraform
resource "coolify_application_start" "start_my_app" {
  application_uuid = coolify_application_dockerimage.api.id
  force            = false
  instant_deploy   = true
}
```

## Argumentos e Atributos

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_uuid` (String) UUID of the application to start.

### Optional

- `force` (Boolean) Force restart even if the application is already running.
- `instant_deploy` (Boolean) Deploy immediately when starting.

### Read-Only

- `deployment_uuid` (String) UUID of the deployment triggered by the start action.
- `message` (String) Status message returned by the Coolify API after the start action.

## Importação

```shell
terraform import coolify_application_start.example <application-uuid>
```
